params.query:
FROM logs-system.auth-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= "2026-07-26T19:02:22Z" AND @timestamp < "2026-07-26T20:02:22Z"
        AND host.name == "web-1"
        AND message LIKE "*sudo:*"
| STATS attempts   = COUNT(*),
        sessions   = COUNT(*) WHERE message LIKE "*session opened*",
        auth_fail  = COUNT(*) WHERE message LIKE "*authentication failure*",
        first_seen = MIN(@timestamp),
        last_seen  = MAX(@timestamp)
        BY user.name
| SORT attempts DESC

FROM logs-system.auth-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= "2026-07-26T19:02:22Z" AND @timestamp < "2026-07-26T20:02:22Z"
        AND host.name == "web-1"
        AND (message LIKE "*session opened*" OR message LIKE "*session closed*")
| STATS opened     = COUNT(*) WHERE message LIKE "*session opened*",
        closed     = COUNT(*) WHERE message LIKE "*session closed*",
        first_seen = MIN(@timestamp),
        last_seen  = MAX(@timestamp)
        BY host.name

FROM logs-system.auth-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= "2026-07-26T19:02:22Z" AND @timestamp < "2026-07-26T20:02:22Z"
        AND host.name == "web-1"
        AND event.outcome IS NOT NULL
| STATS accepted   = COUNT(*) WHERE event.outcome == "success",
        failed     = COUNT(*) WHERE event.outcome == "failure",
        first_seen = MIN(@timestamp),
        last_seen  = MAX(@timestamp)
        BY auth_method = CASE(message LIKE "*publickey*", "publickey",
                              message LIKE "*password*",  "password", "other"),
           source.ip, user.name
| SORT accepted DESC, failed DESC

FROM logs-system.auth-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= "2026-07-26T19:02:22Z" AND @timestamp < "2026-07-26T20:02:22Z"
        AND host.name == "web-1"
| STATS total = COUNT(*),
        with_outcome = COUNT(*) WHERE event.outcome IS NOT NULL,
        with_message = COUNT(*) WHERE message IS NOT NULL,
        first_seen = MIN(@timestamp),
        last_seen  = MAX(@timestamp)
        BY data_stream.dataset

FROM logs-system.auth-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= "2026-07-26T19:02:22Z" AND @timestamp < "2026-07-26T20:02:22Z"
        AND host.name == "web-1"
        AND message LIKE "*sudo:*"
| STATS attempts = COUNT(*),
        first_seen = MIN(@timestamp),
        last_seen  = MAX(@timestamp)
        BY user.name, command = GROK(message, "%{DATA}COMMAND=%{DATA:command}$")
| SORT attempts DESC

FROM logs-system.auth-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= "2026-07-26T19:02:22Z" AND @timestamp < "2026-07-26T20:02:22Z"
        AND host.name == "web-1"
        AND (message LIKE "*Accepted*" OR message LIKE "*Failed password*")
| STATS accepted = COUNT(*) WHERE message LIKE "*Accepted*",
        failed   = COUNT(*) WHERE message LIKE "*Failed password*",
        first_seen = MIN(@timestamp),
        last_seen  = MAX(@timestamp)
        BY source.ip, user.name
| SORT accepted DESC, failed DESC

FROM logs-system.auth-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= "2026-07-26T19:02:22Z" AND @timestamp < "2026-07-26T20:02:22Z"
        AND host.name == "web-1"
        AND message LIKE "*sudo:*"
